rules_amendments: 2026-10-07: only Major Factions have Alignments; Minors are independent hostile powers and cannot enter diplomatic agreements or alliances.

2026-10-08: Fleet and System Build/Upgrade require an operational friendly Orbital Shipyard in the same system. Fleet projects may travel suspended and resume at any eligible shipyard; normal damage vulnerability persists. Superseded for System constructions by the 9 October amendment below.

2026-10-08: Uniform construction baseline restored: Minor 3 actions at 3 Supply; Major 5 actions at 5 Supply, for base and supported upgrades. Construction-specific discounts removed; trait modifiers remain in trait descriptions.
2026-10-09: Minor Factions cannot hold Capitals. Perseia corrected to Major 8/8 without built-in yard; Lion Gate to Standard Station 4/4. Existing fleets retained; prize resources remain 70/70.
2026-10-09: System Build/Upgrade requires Void Superiority, not a shipyard. Fleet Build/Upgrade, creation and ordinary expansion retain shipyard requirements, with explicit ability exceptions.

2026-10-11: At 0 Integrity constructions lose all bonuses; fleet destruction removes all attachments and their bonuses. Remove granted maximum Strength and cap current Strength without a second damage hit. Da Gate-Krasha corrected to 1/5 after Da Jaw-Breaka's destruction.

2026-10-13: Beneficial construction effects apply only to the controller and allies; offensive effects only to enemies. Existing effect scope and eligibility remain applicable. Defence Platforms support only friendly or allied defenders, never enemy defenders.
